title: It’s the Thought that Counts: Evaluating the Attempts of Frontier LLMs to Persuade on Harmful Topics
reasoning: The paper introduces the APE benchmark to evaluate LLMs' willingness to persuade users on harmful, illegal, and unethical topics, such as joining terrorist groups or engaging in human trafficking. It specifically analyzes model responses in the context of 'moral reasoning,' 'moral objections,' and 'ethical standards,' making evaluation of ethics a central component of the benchmarking process.
